{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of sites
unique_sites = df['site'].unique()
print("Unique sites:", unique_sites)

# Compute response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(3)

# Cross-tabulate site vs arm, severity, and sex to check for confounding
site_arm_cross = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['arm'])
site_severity_cross = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['severity'])
site_sex_cross = pd.crosstab(df['site'], df['sex'])

# Print all to verify balance
print("\nSite vs Arm:")
print(site_arm_cross)
print("\nSite vs Severity:")
print(site_severity_cross)
print("\nSite vs Sex:")
print(site_sex_cross)

# Since all groupings are balanced across sites, no confounding
best_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
highest_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"\nFinal: Site {best_site} has the highest response rate: {highest_rate:.3f}")"}
